fields.title: marchespublics.gouv.dj Djibouti tender/award record
fields.description: One record per row. Shape depends on recordType: CURRENT_TENDER (listType=current, a tender card from the portal's first page) or TENDER_AWARD (listType=awards, this week's contract-award notice with supplier and amount). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a request fails or is unreachable.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: Which list this record came from: 'list:current' or 'list:awards'.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record, or 'none' on error.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on a failed run (blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

title.title: Title
title.description: CURRENT_TENDER only -- what is being procured.

code.title: Code
code.description: CURRENT_TENDER only -- the tender's own reference code, often blank upstream.

administrationContractante.title: Administration contractante
administrationContractante.description: CURRENT_TENDER only -- the contracting government body.

nature.title: Nature
nature.description: CURRENT_TENDER only -- e.g. 'Services', 'Fournitures et services', 'Prestations Intellectuelles'.

dateParution.title: Date de parution
dateParution.description: CURRENT_TENDER only -- upstream publication date, frequently 'N/A' as published.

dateLimiteRemiseOffres.title: Date limite de remise des offres
dateLimiteRemiseOffres.description: CURRENT_TENDER only -- upstream bid submission deadline, frequently 'N/A' as published.

projet.title: Projet
projet.description: TENDER_AWARD only -- the funding project, or 'Aucun Projet' if none.

institution.title: Institution
institution.description: TENDER_AWARD only -- the contracting government body.

supplier.title: Supplier
supplier.description: TENDER_AWARD only -- the winning company's name.

amountDJF.title: Amount (DJF)
amountDJF.description: TENDER_AWARD only -- the awarded amount in Djibouti Francs, upstream free-text (space-separated thousands).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both record types -- rows missing a given column render blank.
